name: Terraria 2
source:
A tale of two souls who are tasked to venture into a realm of existence they have never seen before. 

Will they find what Mr Sink failed to retrieve?
Will they learn the value of what the essence of life truly is?
translation:
两个灵魂受命前往一个从未见过的存在领域，由此展开一段故事。

他们能找到辛克先生未能取回的东西吗？
他们能领悟生命本质的真正价值吗？
